info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Permits-v4-spec
info.description: The List Parking Reservations API enables users to retrieve detailed information about parking reservations permits. This endpoint is particularly useful for event organizers or agencies managing parking facilities, allowing them to easily access and review existing reservations. Through this API, users can query and obtain data for specific permits, ensuring effective management of parking resources. Ideal for developers building applications that require parking reservation data, this API streamlines the process of accessing relevant information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details of a reservation permit. It provides information related to the specific reservation identified by the permit.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for fetching reservation permits. The client must provide the necessary information in JSON format to retrieve the requested permits.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the reservation permit data.

ListParkingReservationsPermitsRequest.description: A JSON string representation of the request body used for retrieving reservations permits.

ListParkingReservationsPermitsResponse_2.title: Reservations Permit Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier referencing the reservation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the reservation permit.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message accompanying the response, providing additional information.

audit.description: Audit information related to the creation of the reservation.

ListParkingReservationsPermitsResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response for a successful GET request to retrieve reservation permit details.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Name or identifier of the user or system that created the reservation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the reservation creation was done automatically by a system.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing audit details about the reservation creation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This header helps in understanding the performance of the API endpoint.
